groups.name: Hillcrest Community Choir
groups.description: A friendly community choir. Rehearsals on Tuesdays, two concerts a year.

groups.name: Hillcrest Dog Park Friends

groups.name: Hillcrest Cycling Club
groups.description: Weekend group rides at every pace. New riders are approved by a ride leader.

groups.name: Friends of Hillcrest Library

events.title: Book sale
events.description: Volunteer shifts for the winter sale, twelve spots in all. Wear layers, the community room stays cold until the heat kicks in, and the small lot fills fast, so street parking is easier.

events.title: Park cleanup
events.description: First cleanup of the year. We will clear branches from the winter storms and fill the low spots by the fountain. Gloves and bags provided, one guest per member, and dogs are better off at home for this one.

events.title: Spring sing-along
events.description: Come sing with us, no experience needed. Songbooks are handed out at the door and there is tea and cookies at the break. Up to two guests per member, kids welcome.

events.title: Season opener ride
events.description: Our first group ride of the season, about 25 miles with a short cut for anyone who wants it. Members only. Pump your tires before you come and bring a spare tube; the ride leader goes over hand signals at 7:50.

events.title: Spring cleanup
events.description: Raking, weeding the fence line and fresh wood chips for the small dog area. If it pours we push to the next Saturday. One guest per member.

events.title: Author talk
events.description: A local author reads from her new mystery, set in a town a lot like ours, then takes questions. Seating tops out at 50, so one guest each. Copies will be for sale at the desk.

events.title: Spring concert
events.description: The spring program runs about an hour with one intermission. Free to attend, and donations go toward new sheet music. Members can hold up to four guest seats; the church lot opens at 6:30.

events.title: Lakeshore 40
events.description: Forty miles around the lake at a steady pace, with a water stop at the halfway turnaround. Members only. The trailhead lot is small, so carpool or ride over, and helmets are required.

events.title: Summer solstice sing
events.description: Light summer songs outdoors at the bandstand. Bring a blanket or a folding chair. Rain moves us into the church hall, and you can bring up to three guests.

events.title: Summer reading kickoff
events.description: Kids pick up their reading logs and a free book to start the summer, and there is a short puppet show at 11. Children need a spot too, and each member can add two guests.

events.title: Pup splash day
events.description: Kiddie pools, sprinklers and a lot of wet dogs. Bring a towel and maybe a change of shoes for yourself. Dogs must be current on shots; two guests per member.

events.title: Hill climb morning
events.description: Repeats on Ridge Road, as many as you like, turning at the top each time. Capped at 20 riders, members only. Bring two bottles, it warms up fast once the sun clears the hill.

events.title: Fall season kickoff
events.description: Morning meeting to start the fall term: music handout, voice checks for new singers and a short rehearsal. Members only. Coffee and pastries from 9:45.

events.title: Fall colors ride
events.description: Easy social ride out past the orchards and back, roughly 30 miles with a coffee stop. Members only. It is chilly at the start, so bring a layer that fits in a jersey pocket.

events.title: Book sale
events.description: Twelve volunteer spots for the fall sale across setup, cashier and pack-up. Comfortable shoes and a water bottle help. Members only; message the sale coordinator if you need to swap shifts.

events.title: Howl-o-ween costume parade
events.description: Costume parade around the big field at 11:30, with small prizes for funniest and most homemade. Leave the candy at home, chocolate is dangerous for dogs. Up to three guests per member.

events.title: Holiday story time
events.description: Winter stories, a snowflake craft and cocoa in the children's room. Each child takes a spot, and members can bring up to two guests. Stroller parking is by the back door.

events.title: Winter concert
events.description: Carols, a few new pieces and a singalong to close the night. Admission is free and the bake sale table helps pay for the hall. Up to four guest seats per member, doors at 6:30.

events.title: Holiday pup photos
events.description: A volunteer with a good camera takes holiday portraits by the big tree, free, with photos emailed the week after. Bring a squeaky toy to get your dog looking up. Two guests per member.

events.title: Book sale
events.description: We need twelve volunteers for the winter sale. The cash box and price signs are in the storeroom, and the book sale coordinator will walk first timers through checkout. Members only.

events.title: Spring sing-along
events.description: This year it is all songs from musicals, with the words on a screen so nobody has to read music. Two guests per member. The hall is step free from the side door.

events.title: Season opener ride
events.description: Shake off the winter legs with a flat 20 miles, regrouping at every turn. Members only. The shop opens early for a quick air check, and we roll at 8 sharp.

events.title: Spring cleanup
events.description: Work day at the north gate. This spring we are patching the fence line and painting the benches, so wear clothes you do not mind ruining. One guest each, donuts at 10.

events.title: Spring concert
events.description: Spring program with a few new arrangements and a guest pianist in the second half. Free, with a donation basket by the door, and up to four guests per member. Singers warm up at 6:15 in the side chapel.

events.title: Lakeshore 40
events.description: Second year for this one: 40 miles around the lake with a rest stop run by club volunteers. Members only, 30 riders max. If thunderstorms are forecast, the ride leaders will post a go or no go by 6 that morning.

events.title: Summer reading kickoff
events.description: Sign up for summer reading, get your log and pick out a free paperback. A neighbor with a guitar plays a few songs at 10:45. Two guests per member, and children count toward the 40 spots.

events.title: Pup splash day
events.description: Pools, a sprinkler and frozen treats, plus a separate splash corner for small dogs. Check the supplies sheet if you can lend a pool or towels. Two guests per member; dogs that dislike water stay leashed near the pools.

events.title: Fall season kickoff
events.description: Fall term starts here. We will hand out the winter music, collect dues and read through two pieces. Members only, and new singers should come at 9:30 for a quick range check.

events.title: Century practice ride
events.description: A 70 mile practice for anyone eyeing a century, with stops at miles 25 and 50 and a sweeper at the back. Members only, 25 riders max. Bring food you know your stomach can handle.

events.title: Book sale
events.description: Fall sale volunteers, twelve spots across three shifts. Pack-up is always the hardest to fill, so if you have a car, please consider it. Members only; questions go to the book sale coordinator.

events.title: Howl-o-ween costume parade
events.description: Year two of the parade. Judging starts at 11:30, and there is a new category for matching owner and dog costumes. Up to three guests each, and keep costumes clear of eyes and noses.

events.title: Winter concert
events.description: Our winter program, with the children's choir joining for two songs. Free; donations welcome.

events.title: Concert dress rehearsal
events.description: Full run with risers and lights. Black clothes.

events.title: Saturday park cleanup
events.description: Rake, restock bags and spread mulch by the benches. Coffee provided.

events.title: Holiday book sale volunteers
events.description: Volunteer shifts for the holiday book sale.

events.title: Holiday story time
events.description: Winter stories and a craft. Children need a place too; babies under two do not.

events.title: Howl-iday costume parade
events.description: Costumes optional, treats guaranteed.

events.title: Winter base miles ride
events.description: 30 easy miles, regroup at every turn.

events.title: Spring program planning
events.description: Section leads and helpers plan the spring program.
